headline: Nairobi Suburbs Record Rise in House Prices and Rental Growth in Third Quarter
summary: House prices in Nairobi's suburbs rose by 2.3 percent in the third quarter of 2026, while rental prices increased by 2.7 percent amid steady consumer demand.
why: Real estate price indices in key urban centers reflect local inflation trends, consumer purchasing power, and urban property sector yields.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Quarterly increases in suburban house prices and rents signal firm residential real estate demand in Nairobi.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
